tool_input.description: Inspect events CSV head and line count
Filter rows by contract rules into valid CSV and rejected id list

tool_input.command:
rm -f .tmp/valid.csv .tmp/rejected.txt
awk -f .tmp/filter.awk data/events.csv
echo "valid rows (incl header):"; wc -l < .tmp/valid.csv
echo "rejected count:"; wc -l < .tmp/rejected.txt 2>/dev/null || echo 0
echo "--- rejected ids ---"; sort .tmp/rejected.txt | head -40
tool_input.description: Run awk filter and report counts
Show full data for rejected rows

tool_input.command:
echo "=== head valid.csv ==="; head -3 .tmp/valid.csv
echo "=== any empty amounts in valid? ==="; awk -F, 'NR>1 && $4=="" {c++} END{print c+0}' .tmp/valid.csv
echo "=== min/max amount in valid ==="; awk -F, 'NR>1{a=$4+0; if(NR==2||a<mn)mn=a; if(NR==2||a>mx)mx=a} END{print mn, mx}' .tmp/valid.csv
echo "=== distinct categories in valid ==="; awk -F, 'NR>1{print $5}' .tmp/valid.csv | sort -u
echo "=== duplicate row_ids? ==="; awk -F, 'NR>1{print $1}' .tmp/valid.csv | sort | uniq -d | head

sort -u .tmp/rejected.txt | awk 'BEGIN{printf "{\"rejected\": ["} {printf "%s\"%s\"", (NR>1?", ":""), $1} END{print "]}"}' > submission/answers.json
echo "wrote submission/answers.json:"; cat submission/answers.json | head -c 400; echo
echo "count in json:"; grep -o 'R[0-9]*' submission/answers.json | wc -l

hops fg create events054bc3 --version 1 \
  --primary-key row_id \
  --event-time event_time \
  --online \
  --features "row_id:string:record key,account_id:string,event_time:bigint:epoch ms,amount:double,category:string" \
  --description "Events validated against data contract; valid rows only" 2>&1 | tail -20
